hero.title: vorkurs designs and builds digital products for climate, finance and mission‑driven organisations.
hero.subtitle: Strategy, design and code in one team, from the first question to launch and after.
hero.note: The name comes from the *Vorkurs*, the Bauhaus preliminary course where every student started with materials, form and function before anything else.

cases.title: brandmelder
cases.outcome: From brand design to a live site in under two weeks, with a halftone tool that keeps every story on-brand.

media.alt: Bushfire photo in the house duotone
media.caption: The halftone generator, running live. Editors upload a photo, set the dots and pick a colour.

media.alt: brandmelder homepage with a halftone lead image
media.caption: Homepage

cases.text:
brandmelder is a non-profit climate journalism project by Netzwerk Klimajournalismus Deutschland. Working with the Berlin studio NEW STANDARD.S, we took their brand design to a live site in under two weeks.

Inside the CMS we built a halftone image generator, starting from the studio's p5.js prototype. Every article image now comes out of it, so the site stays on-brand without a designer in the loop.

cases.text:
CrossBoundary is one of the largest sustainable-development investment firms working in the Global South. Partnering with backendforth, we led development of their multi-site platform.

We turned the component system into a scalable frontend, so complex financial content reads clearly and every regional site and sub-brand stays visually consistent.

cases.title: citizenM

full_case.outcome: Campaigns that generated €20M+ in revenue, the brand's best-performing to date, kept unmistakably citizenM on every surface.

media.alt: Sleep like a champion campaign landing page
media.caption: “Sleep like a champion”, campaign landing page

blocks.text:
citizenM is a global hotel brand built on a strong visual identity and an irreverent tone of voice. As the in-house creative lead, the job was to carry that identity into every digital surface, from a CRM system reaching millions of subscribers to paid campaigns across Meta, Google and programmatic channels.

We built and maintained the brand's design system in Figma, set up templates the marketing team could scale, and directed a short brand film end to end. An in-house content team took over photography and short-form video from external agencies, saving more than €50K a year.

blocks.heading: The approach
blocks.text:
The work sat where brand, web and performance meet. Every landing page, CRM flow and campaign had to feel playful, bold and never self-serious, while also pulling its weight commercially. That meant a visual system that could flex across dozens of campaigns without losing coherence.

At its centre is a web design system in Figma: reusable components, templates, Auto Layout structures and design tokens. It gave the in-house team and external partners one foundation to work from, and let campaigns turn around fast without starting from scratch.

media.alt: Sleep quiz question about wake-up time
media.caption: Sleep quiz: one question at a time

blocks.heading: Testing as part of the creative loop
blocks.text: Campaign performance fed straight back into design. A/B tests, Hotjar heatmaps and Google Analytics showed which patterns actually converted, and the design system was sharpened on that evidence rather than on how a mockup looked.

media.caption: Rome opening, with booking built into the page
Seasonal sale, same template, new story

media.caption: Paid social, Rome opening
Short brand film, directed end to end

blocks.heading: Role
blocks.text:
Leading the campaign team in citizenM's Brand Studio meant owning web design across the digital ecosystem: setting creative direction, defining quality benchmarks and keeping one visual language across every page and touchpoint, alongside running the A/B tests and iterating on conversion data.

Alongside the creative work: mentoring a junior designer, reviewing the team's output, and managing external agencies, photographers and production partners. Every launch was shaped with Marketing, Product and Content, with design decisions tied to business KPIs.

cases.title: Solea
meta: Design and build for a workplace wellbeing start-up, Amsterdam
cases.outcome: A booking platform of its own, so therapists keep their clients, their prices and their full fee.

media.caption: Thai yoga massage, from the brand film

media.alt: Solea booking screen: treatment, duration, day and time slots
media.caption: Booking: treatment, duration, day, time

cases.text:
Solea brings certified practitioners into Amsterdam offices: Thai yoga massage, chair massage and more. We designed the brand and built a browser-based booking app on top of it.

Employees at partner offices book a slot in the weekly treatment room and pay the therapist directly, without a large platform taking a cut of every session.

cases.title: Erik Kessels × Gallerie d'Italia
cases.outcome: A 360° room where an algorithm stitches thousands of archive photographs into one moving image.

media.alt: The projection room at Gallerie d'Italia
media.caption: The installation, Publifoto Archive

cases.text:
We worked with artist Erik Kessels on Un'Immagine, a large-scale immersive installation built from the Publifoto Archive, with a continuously moving 360° image and sound.

We were the bridge between the creative and the technical: interpreting the artistic vision, coordinating between the artist and the exhibition venue, managing the creative dialogue and overseeing delivery.
